newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease on profit-taking, trade calm.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease on profit-taking, trade calm.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased in calm trading on Wednesday on speculative selling and profit-taking, dealers said.

"The West was selling the third, fifth and, less actively, the fourth tranches in early trading. The mood seemed to be to take profits after the market has risen two to three big figures in the recent 1.5 weeks," one dealer said.
Dealers said the most active third, fourth and fifth tranches traded on Wednesday within ranges of 81.30-82.00, 58.20-58.90 and 41.20-42.00, respectively.
Avtobank dealer Pavel Afanasyev said Wednesday's fluctuations were merely speculative as there had been no market-moving news.
